description: LEGACY ACTIVITY BOARD (retired as a payout table — Rokha runs no platform payouts). Builders and promoters ranked on one activity score this round — built (distinct others ran your listings), operated, brought (referrals who then ran something), scouted, sold, plus pin_points. Each row carries rank, points by lane, its ticket (ran for a distinct other · payout wallet · audit clean), `lane`, `page_url`; `top10`, `paid_place` and the payout line are kept for old clients and pay nothing. Use market_search (GET /api/market) or front_board (GET /api/front) for the live, most-used board. `section` = 'incubation' (default) or 'members' (legacy names); `week` = YYYY-MM-DD, default the current round.

section.description: Which section of the legacy board.

week.description: The round date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the current round.
